summary: Sets a game-state parameter on the global object at 0x008B89A0 via its vtable entry at offset 252. Skips entirely when a2 is -1 or equals the previously stored state this[14]. Maps a2 (0, 1, 2) to dispatch value (1, 3, 2) and records a2 into this[14] on change.

operations.description: Skip when a2 is -1 or when a2 already equals the stored previous state this[14] (offset 0x38).
When a2 is 0, dispatch on the global object at 0x008B89A0 through vtable+252 with (*this, 13, 1).
When a2 is 1, dispatch on the global object at 0x008B89A0 through vtable+252 with (*this, 13, 3).
When a2 is 2, dispatch on the global object at 0x008B89A0 through vtable+252 with (*this, 13, 2).
Record the new value a2 into this[14] (offset 0x38) after a successful dispatch.

unresolved: The meaning of state parameter 13 and of the 1/3/2 value mapping is owned by the vtable+252 handler on the global object, not by this function.
this[14] (offset 0x38) is compared and updated here but consumed elsewhere.
